findings.issue: The not-run half of cf31c/cf31d is recorded through _harness.skip(check, other, ..., True): `absent` is the constant True, so the helper failing direction (skipped on a host that has the mechanism) can never fire. The half is chosen by the same top_folds read that picks the half that ran, so it is true by construction, but on a mixed volume (project tree folds and .claude tells case apart, or the reverse) cf31c label still says `on a real volume that folds case` while only the folder row is held, and nothing marks the mixed case as neither kind. Only SKIPPED HERE is printed, so a reader cannot tell a mixed volume from a plain one except through the printed pair of folds answers.
findings.resolution: Pass the evidence the helper asks for (for the not-run half, the negation of the disk read that selected the other half), and when top_folds != cdir_folds label the case as the mixed volume rather than as either kind.

findings.issue: The cf29 budget for a write that creates its file allows `links` = len(rel) extra calls (2) while the measured extra by the question own source is 1 (cf-new.ts: 4 before, 5 now, allowance 2, in after.folding.out). A single disk call added to that write path still passes `within` (6 <= 6); only the call-for-call comparisons `now == today` and `now == off` catch it, so the claim that the budget is what turns an added call red holds for the existing-file write (allowance 0, exact) but not for the creating one. The mutation row for a disk call added to the config question path went red through the call-for-call half, not the budget.
findings.resolution: Say in the comment above _before (the call-for-call paragraph) that the added calls of a creating write are held by `now == today`, not by the budget; or tighten the allowance to the measured link count per host once windows CI has printed it.

intent.note: Task clause (a), cf31 named STUBBED asks the REAL disk first, and rule 1: either drive the unit the model stands in for (the walk that judges one component in the directory holding it) or substitute every question on the driven path. The diff drives _config._case_walk(top, parts, rel) directly with _one_entry and _volume_folds substituted, and records every other counted disk call through _disk_record(outer=True), failing unless each is of a path spelled as the config own (the stray list in _walk_cases). Rule 2, asserted against the real volume read from the disk, held where it folds and allowed where it tells case apart: cf31c/cf31d use _swapped_exists(cdir) and _swapped_differs(cdir), print which half ran, and print the other as SKIPPED HERE; cf32e adds the disk-image twin. Rule 3, count what the hold itself asks: cf29 budget is now _disk_calls(..., outer=True) with an allowance of one link question per CONFIG_REL component for a creating write, both totals printed. Rule 4 and acceptance 4: the diff of plugins/ against HEAD is empty, so hooks/_config.py is unchanged. Checked against the run outputs: after.folding.out and after.sensitive.out both 147/147; before2.sensitive.out shows the old cf31 failing at 143/144 on the case-sensitive image with the dir-variant row answering allow and no question recorded, the same line as the ubuntu log; mutations.out ends MUTATIONS ALL CAUGHT. The executor outcome describes the diff: the cf29 and cf31 labels, the new cf31c/cf31d/cf32e and the SECURITY.md sentences match the lines read. SECURITY.md is outside the task named files, but its cf29 sentence (no more in total than before) had become true only by the posix leaf measure, so correcting it is within the claim; the outcome names it. Floor guard: the cf29, cf31 and cf31b gone labels are rewordings of cases the task was told to rebuild; cf29 bar is lowered on purpose (leaf total to outer total plus link allowance, rule 3) and the call-for-call halves keep the leaf measure, so no unrelated check is weakened. cf31 hook-level substituted rows are replaced by walk-level rows; the hook-to-walk wiring (_one_place passing (folder, name) and (own_folder, own) to _case_walk) is then asserted only on a real volume (cf31c/cf31d/cf32e), as rules 1 and 2 intend. Windows-only lines the executor names (cf31c held half on NTFS, cf29 outer counts 6 vs 4 and 4 vs 5) are predicted from the CI log and unverified here.
